summary: Keep bounded failed CLI evidence and support safe named or tail variadic comparisons.
reason: Pitch comparisons emit valid partial facts before a nonzero exit; discarding stdout hides those facts from MCP clients. Captured or serialized overflow must remain a labeled preview. Named variadic strings must reach the CLI as individual validated operands; arrays are not part of the advertised string schema.
validated_outcome: Actual failed-child and real stdio comparisons retain bounded partial evidence; named/tail variadic strings reach individual validated operands, arrays and flag injection fail explicitly, scalar questions remain whole.
